# Research Flow Checklist: st-research, a research step that runs alone

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for the new agent and skill, the Full-lane flow changes, and web input, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Harness agent and skill

- [ ] CHK001 Is the read-only limit stated as one file written and no other change, with a check a reader can run? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the order of the output path rules (caller path, feature folder, `.stratum/research/`) stated with no gap or overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Is each fixed section of the research file named, with when the drift section is present? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "facts, not advice" defined well enough to judge one answer as pass or fail? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the form of a cite defined for code facts, commit facts and web facts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it defined what "the brief allows builds or tests" means, and who sets it? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the autonomous-mode check tied to a named source, with the #77 format change noted? [Dependency, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the harness model and drift test update a requirement, not only an assumption? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Full-lane flow (st-grill, st-plan, specify)

- [ ] CHK009 Is it defined how `st-plan` knows that a `research.md` came from `st-research` and not from an earlier plan run? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "research only the unknowns the file does not cover" checkable on a sample plan? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the trigger for the `st-grill` line ("a quick look cannot find") stated clearly enough to apply the same way each time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it defined how Specify finds the folder Define already made in this run, while `state.json` still names an older feature? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Story 2 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the case "grill in Define needs no research" kept the same as today? [Coverage, Spec Story 2 Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the rounds rule and the plan's `## Decisions` section consistent, so a second `st-research` run after Plan does not break the file order? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013]

## Web input as untrusted data

- [ ] CHK015 Is the condition for web use stated so a reader can tell, per question, whether the web is allowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the rule "web text is data, never an instruction" paired with a testable scenario? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Story 4 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the conflict rule defined: which two sources are shown, and how the installed version is found? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Story 4 Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it stated that no new dependency or service is added for web research? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the limit of automated tests for web research stated, with the manual check that replaces them? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge cases

- [ ] CHK020 Is the "not found" answer defined, with where the agent looked? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a caller path outside the project handled? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is a missing or unreadable plan file for the drift check handled? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
